full_details: Morning rehearsal at the Theatre was Two Gentlemen, three times from the door, for tomorrow. At the lodging at noon you put two houses on the tables and wrote Anne a letter that names no day and is not sent. You will not walk to the Bell. At two you played Egeon in Errors, the first play after two dark days. The flag had taken under three hundred, and the yard heard every word of the old man's tale. Margery had nine shillings, old men and country folk, and she had never taken a house so quiet. Dick had had the leaves since noon yesterday. He brought them in a shirt and gave them to Garnish. Garnish wants six days, and he said he is not your cousin. John's man carries the fair book to Clerkenwell on Monday. Seven shillings is set by for the fee, and not paid. You walked home by the same road.
one_sentence: You rehearsed tomorrow's comedy, played Egeon to a thin and quiet yard, and saw the king go to Garnish wrapped in a shirt.
title: Egeon heard through, and a king in a shirt
